officialLinks.label: GPA formula, transfer exclusion and precision

helpIntro: Marquette uses a 4.000 scale. Enter semester hours and final undergraduate grades; GPA is total grade points divided by GPA-bearing semester hours.
helpNote: For the standard current undergraduate record. Transfer grades do not enter Marquette GPA. Repeat Impact is unavailable because undergraduate repeat treatment depends on the highest eligible Marquette grade.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.00 grade points; a 3-credit B+ earns 9.99. Together, 21.99 ÷ 6 = 3.665.

specialTypes.name: Marquette undergraduate course
specialTypes.note: Use the final Marquette grade and semester hours for a standard undergraduate course.

specialTypes.name: External transfer course
specialTypes.note: Transfer credits may apply toward the degree, but transferred grades are not included in Marquette GPA.

specialTypes.name: Repeated or unusual attempt
specialTypes.note: Undergraduate repeats generally keep the highest eligible Marquette grade in cumulative GPA, with exceptions and attempt limits. Use CheckMarq/Registrar treatment before entering the counted attempt.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is unavailable. Confirm which attempt CheckMarq counts, then enter only the GPA-bearing attempt in this estimate.
